title: The Geoengineering Put: Ecological Debt, Termination Risk, and Asset Prices
abstract: arXiv:2611.21568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Solar geoengineering offers an inexpensive and fast-acting way to lower global temperatures without removing carbon from the atmosphere. As warming intensifies, climate-vulnerable countries face growing incentives to deploy geoengineering unilaterally. The economic and financial consequences of this prospect remain largely overlooked. We develop a general equilibrium macro-finance framework in which geoengineering acts as a put option on climate damages, funded by the "ecological debt" of masked warming. If deployment stops, temperatures snap back in a catastrophic termination shock. Anticipation of geoengineering raises current brown firm valuations and lowers the optimal carbon tax, helping explain two puzzles in the existing literature: high brown-firm valuations and low carbon taxes. translated_title: 地球工程的看跌期权：生态债务、终止风险与资产价格
translated_abstract: 太阳能地球工程提供了一种成本低、见效快的方法来降低全球温度，而无需从大气中移除碳。随着气候变暖加剧，气候脆弱国家单边部署地球工程的动机日益增强。然而，这一前景所带来的经济与金融后果在很大程度上被忽视了。我们构建了一个一般均衡的宏观金融框架，其中地球工程充当针对气候损害的看跌期权，其资金来源是被掩盖的变暖所累积的“生态债务”。一旦部署停止，气温将出现灾难性的“终止冲击”式反弹。对地球工程的预期会推高当前棕色（高碳）企业的估值并降低最优碳税，这有助于解释现有文献中的两个谜题：棕色企业估值偏高与碳税偏低。然而，随着生态债务不断累积，终止风险会将棕色企业变为有毒资产。地球工程还重塑了绿色创新：它为人类争取了时间……
tldr: 本文构建一般均衡宏观金融框架，将地球工程视为气候损害的看跌期权，揭示了其对棕色企业估值、最优碳税和资产价格的影响，以及终止风险如何随着生态债务累积将棕色企业转变为有毒资产。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general equilibrium macro-finance framework in which geoengineering acts as a put option on climate damages, showing how it raises brown firm valuations and lowers carbon taxes, while growing ecological debt and termination risk turn brown firms into toxic assets.
